comparison.objective: Slide an exit-door bolt about 5 cm into its unlocked seat; candidate adjusts and locks damping, then validates dynamic stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-axis thumb-slide actuation versus recessed-key insertion, counterholding, collar rotation, locking torque, and repeated guarded cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Bolt seated at the travel endpoint versus energy-rated, non-bottoming repeated stops with rebound and setting-drift limits.
comparison.reason: A generic sliding motion is insufficient to establish overlap with iterative damper commissioning. No spec versions or seating tolerance were provided.
